.end

============================================================
 CANDIDATE 7
============================================================

 For this constraint, try a 3.3V to 277V boost, 200W. You must increase the voltage gain. The previous netlist used an L1=47u, but this is too small for 3.3V to 277V boost. The inductor must be larger, and the switching frequency must be lower to increase the duty cycle. For a boost, D = 1 - Vin/Vout = 1 - 3.3/277 = 0.985, so the on-time must be much longer. Try 100u inductor, 10kHz switching. Recalculate the timing and component values.
.tran 10n 1m
.model NMOS NMOS(Vto=1 Kp=2 Lambda=0)
.model DIODE D
Vin in 0 3.3
L1 in sw 100u
M1 sw gate 0 0 NMOS W=1 L=1
D1 sw out DIODE
C1 out 0 220u
Rload out 0 380
Vgate gate 0 PULSE(0 12 0 1n 1n 985n 100u)
.save V(*) I(*)
.end
